title: Chapter 297 The First Round Of Competition
content:
Chapter 297 The First Round Of Competition

Each side dispatched nearly 10,000 people, an unprecedented scale.

In front of the endless cavalry formation, both sides used various formations, skills and props to increase speed.

Looking down from the sky, in the plain with rolling hills on all sides, three groups of people approached quickly, like three boulders about to collide with each other.

In the Nanshan Alliance camp, the Hell Knights and the Golden Fire Cavalry were naturally in the front, and the four fierce generals acted as the spearhead.

Wang Shuo, Gong Zheng, Ayub and Ye Tianba.

Wang Shuo slightly side-glanced and glanced left and right.

His blood was boiling in his heart.

It was a great blessing to be able to gallop on the battlefield with a group of brothers in this life.

This battle attracted countless lords from outside the domain to watch.

Some of them were very old, and seeing this scene, they would inevitably miss the scene when they were afraid of blood spilling on the battlefield.

And more lords were observing whether there were any fierce generals among them who could be used by them.

Sooner or later, they will have a chance to intervene in the affairs of the Dahuai Domain.

At that time, if some people can take the initiative to surrender, it will naturally be a great thing.

Wang Shuo looked straight ahead, and the first to bear the brunt of the opposite side was naturally the senior general.

When he was about to get close, Wang Shuo immediately used "Iron Chain Binding", but the target was not the general on the opposite side, but the undead warhorse under his crotch.

"Bang."

With a loud bang, the senior general on the opposite side fell directly to the ground. Although he lost his warhorse, his body was not damaged.

Instead, he drew out the scimitar and chopped at the feet of the three-headed dog of hell.

Tooth for tooth!

The three-headed dog of hell is not comparable to the warhorse.

Da Huang jumped up directly and stepped over the attack of the scimitar.

Passing by each other, neither side took too much advantage.

"Hush..."

A whistle sounded, and the skeleton general summoned the undead warhorse again, and the warhorse at this time was actually intact.

Swords and spears clashed, metal and iron rang.

The battle between the two sides immediately entered a white-hot stage.

Overall, the two sides were evenly matched.

To be precise, the Undead Knights had a slight advantage.

The White Horse Knights could barely fight the Undead Knights on equal terms.

The Hell Knights and the Golden Fire Cavalry had some advantages, but the Wind Chasing Knights and

the Allied Cavalry behind them were a bit lame. They were just following behind, so the casualties were not very large.

The first round of confrontation between the two sides was evenly matched.

Since the health of the soldiers on both sides could not be killed with one hit, they often needed to be hit many times before they could be killed.

Of course, being knocked off the horse, if it was not for the strong strength, it would be another matter.

Wang Shuo equipped everyone with a large amount of life-replenishing pills, so only nearly a hundred people were lost, mainly the Wind Chasing Knights.

The other allied forces of the Nanshan Society suffered much greater losses, reaching hundreds of people.

This is because they followed Wang Shuo's troops and did not bear the most violent attacks, so they only lost so many people.

Wang Shuo looked at the corpses left on the battlefield where they had just fought, and his heart gradually became cold.

"Charge."

In order not to expose the ambush, Wang Shuo did not let the crossbow battalion provide long-range fire support.

And Su Xiu also lost hundreds of people, which made his heart bleed.

War has always been cruel.

There is nothing to say, the second confrontation is about to begin.

This time, Falati concentrated two-thirds of the generals around him.

As a top general, he has recovered many of his memories, and he has remembered many combat capabilities in his previous life.

There are two troops on the opposite side, and he chooses to defeat one of them first.
